summary: This 8-K filing by Amanat Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, reports the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) of 7,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share for gross proceeds of $75 million, and a simultaneous private placement of 300,000 shares to its sponsor for $3 million. Net proceeds of $75 million were deposited in a trust account for public shareholders. As a routine IPO closing report, this filing does not reflect a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, but rather the standard capital formation step of a SPAC after its IPO. No special situation category applies.
